tokenize_dialog_for_finetuning: tokenize a dialog list with user and assistant roles into input_ids and labels for LLM fine-tuning
mask_target_tokens_in_labels: mask a target token sequence within a label list by replacing matches with -100 values
load_oasst1_custom_dataset: load the OpenAssistant oasst1 dataset, build conversation threads, and tokenize them for fine-tuning
build_conversation_threads_from_oasst1: build conversation threads from the oasst1 dataset by following parent-child message relationships
convert_threads_to_dialog_format: convert a flat message thread into a dialog list alternating user and assistant roles
